title: LocaleCommonV1
description: Shared definitions for the locale copy files under i18n/: plain text, the structured rich-text form (no raw HTML), and links. Internal links name a route ID from src/routes.ts, never a locale path, so the locale path rules stay in code. Not a document schema on its own; the locale-*-v1 schemas $ref its $defs.

locale.title: LocaleId
locale.description: The locale this file is authored for; it must match the file's directory (i18n/<locale>/).

text.title: Text
text.description: Plain text: no markup, no variables. Used where the value may end up in an attribute.

rich.title: Rich
rich.description: Rich text: a plain string, or a list of inline nodes rendered in order by src/components/ui/Rich.tsx.

inline.title: Inline
inline.description: One inline node. Each object node has exactly one tag key (b, em, code, span, br, a, var, status, dim, flag, placeholder) plus the attributes that tag allows.

span.title: SpanNode
span.description: <span> with one of the global type classes (src/style.css).

lineBreak.title: LineBreakNode
lineBreak.description: : an authored line break (hero and other large headlines break at an explicit point per locale).

routeRef.title: RouteRef
routeRef.description: An internal link target: a route ID from src/routes.ts (home, community, architecture, architecture/<page>, docs, docs/<page>), optionally followed by #<anchor> from src/content/shared.ts anchors; or #<anchor> alone for the current page. Resolved to /… or /ko/… in code.

httpsUrl.title: HttpsUrl
httpsUrl.description: An external link: an absolute https URL with no credentials.

routeLink.title: RouteLinkNode
routeLink.description: <a> to a page on this site, in the page's own locale.

variable.title: VariableNode
variable.description: A value supplied by the page at render time: a slot (version, date, count) or a fragment the page composes. Never typed into prose (CONVENTIONS.md § Content slots).

status.title: StatusNode
status.description: A status chip (src/components/ui/StatusChip.tsx) inside a sentence.

dim.title: DimNode
dim.description: A dimmed span inside a code sample (RichCode's Dim).

flag.title: FlagNode
flag.description: A flagged span inside a code sample (RichCode's Flag).

link.title: Link
link.description: A labelled link: internal (to, a route ID) or external (href, an https URL). external marks it with ↗.
